headline: Unilever Signals Product Price Increases as Middle East Conflict Raises Costs
summary: Unilever reported 5.2% underlying sales growth for the quarter. The company warned of upcoming product price increases due to mounting freight and input costs related to Middle East conflict.
why: Unilever is one of the world's largest fast-moving consumer goods manufacturers, operating across food, home care, and personal hygiene sectors.

impacts.name: Unilever PLC
impacts.why: Price increases cushion operating profit margins but risk consumer volume pushback.
